output.brief: The drop is not mainly about the app itself, the background check, or a rival group. It comes from the app and the coordinator cuts together. On the basic tier, regulars keep a weekly slot only if staff book it before the Thursday release. Coordinators used to do that. After 1 May, bookings fell from 74 to 3 a week at Dock Street and Westgate. Regulars kept losing their usual slots to new sign-ups, and 88% of those who lost them are now inactive, against 11% of those who kept them. Millbrook has the app and still has a coordinator, and it is stable. Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but has no app, and it is stable. Dock Street and Westgate have both changes, and they are collapsing. The background check cannot explain it: 21 of 23 deactivated volunteers came back, and 121 of 123 lapsed volunteers held a current check. Only 2 lapsed volunteers joined another group. I'm fairly confident. Don't cancel RotaWeave, and don't suspend the check. Have staff or lead volunteers pre-book regulars into their usual slots at Dock Street and Westgate, and phone lapsed regulars to offer slots back. Plan the same for Quarry Lane before its 6 October go-live. Don't strip inactive names from the figures.
